adapter.note: 'NACS adapters are available for purchase from a Polestar Service Point.'

charge_port.note: Polestar doesn't name the port; CCS1 inferred from NACS adapters being sold for Supercharger access.

supercharger_access.note: Polestar 3 page: 'Polestar drivers have access to a growing number of public charging stations compatible with the Combined Charging System (CCS) and the North American Charging Standard (NACS). NACS adapters are available for purchase from a Polestar Service Point.'

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Polestar among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'can be accessed through an adapter. The adapter has to be provided by your vehicle manufacturer.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Polestar US lists prices and stock; maintenance terms reference 'new 2025 Polestar 3 vehicles'. C/D lists 2026 as its latest year. Current model year not stated by Polestar.
